name: hope-capital-castle-construction
reviewNotes: All 14 original glyph records visually reviewed. Covers Hope Capital's castle construction gift, 左源內's work, naming and companion recruitment at the resulting castle.
This is the city-related castle extension; the resulting portable castle and recruited companions are not confined to Hope Capital.
Merchant name 蜂乃屋 confirmed against enlarged source glyphs and the Hope Capital negotiation block; the earlier provisional 蟬乃屋 reading is not used.
Adjacent pointer 0x70162 is an empty raw block: source span 0x94b5d..0x94b5e contains only type byte 00, decodedBytes 0, zero records. There is no empty/control record to translate or compile.
Exact source controls retained. Draft only; no ROM build or native verification.
